brief.headline: Push payment to 30 days and free up ₹2.25 L cash; tap credible alternates to anchor a 10–15% price cut toward ₹0.65–0.80/pc

priceAsk.summary: Ask for 10–15% cut to bring caps into the ₹0.65–0.80/pc range
priceAsk.target: ₹0.65–0.80/pc at higher volume or looser spec
priceAsk.basis: Open-market asking price for a 28 mm induction-wad PP cap is ₹0.55–1.20/pc, typically ₹0.85–0.95/pc; the market verdict says 'MARKET-FAIR; modest headroom to ₹0.65–0.80 at higher volume / looser spec' — so room exists if we commit volume or relax tight tolerances

paymentTermAsk.summary: Move from 45 days to 30 days after receipt
paymentTermAsk.cashImpact: ₹2.25 L cash freed up for us

brief.financialLeverage: This supplier publishes no financials, so we can't see their profit, debt or how tight cash is for them. Our ₹27.42 L annual spend is small but real leverage if we credibly line up a second source. With five strong alternates available — including Manjushree Technopack (₹2569.83 Cr revenue, health score 65/100) and three listed firms — we can push on both price and payment without knowing their balance sheet, because walking to a bigger, proven player is a live option.

evidence.point: We spend ₹27.42 L a year with them on rigid plastic packaging
Cutting payment terms from 45 to 30 days frees up cash for us
Market asking price for a similar cap is ₹0.55–1.20/pc, typically ₹0.85–0.95/pc
Market verdict says modest headroom exists to ₹0.65–0.80/pc at higher volume or looser spec
HDPE resin import unit value benchmark

alternates.name: Manjushree Technopack Ltd
alternates.why: India's largest rigid-plastic packaging converter — pharma bottles, caps, preforms; ₹2569.83 Cr revenue, health score 65/100 — a top second-source candidate

alternates.name: Mold-Tek Packaging Ltd
alternates.why: Listed rigid-plastic leader for pails, containers, pharma packaging — strong, profitable, robust alternate for bottles and closures

alternates.name: Pearl Polymers Ltd
alternates.why: Listed PET bottle and jar specialist (Pearlpet brand) — direct fit for PET bottles if we need to switch

risks: Their financials aren't public, so we can't judge how fragile they are — don't push so hard that a small supplier folds and leaves us scrambling
We have no internal best-price benchmark for this item, so rely entirely on the market ask and alternates to anchor the price discussion
Five market-backup leads (Reliance, Srichakra, IVL Dhunseri, Dalmia, Ganesha, Chemco) are unqualified — verify capability and get quotes before treating any as a real fallback
If we move volume to an alternate, transitioning molds and qualifying new caps takes time — plan a phased shift, not an abrupt cut-off
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We value the partnership, but at ₹27.42 L a year we need sharper pricing — the market shows room at ₹0.65–0.80 for volume — and faster payment at 30 days to free up our cash.
